args.sql:
SELECT
    o.recordvault AS order_id,
    o.dealcount AS total_order_quantity,
    oe.remaincount AS remaining_quantity,
    (o.dealcount - oe.remaincount) / o.dealcount AS order_fill_rate
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark;
